chunks: I heard Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) saying:

Allah, the Exalted, revealed to Muḥammad (صلى الله عليه وآله): “Indeed, I created you when you were not a thing, and I breathed into you from My Spirit as an honor from Me by which I honored you when I made obedience to you obligatory upon all of My creation. So whoever obeys you has obeyed Me, and whoever disobeys you has disobeyed Me. And I made that obligatory regarding ʿAlī and regarding his offspring, from those among them whom I selected for Myself.”

key_terms.أَوْحَى: revealed; denotes divine communication from Allah to a prophet
key_terms.اخْتَصَصْتُهُ: I selected him; denotes divine choosing and special designation
key_terms.الطَّاعَةَ: obedience; the duty of following the divinely appointed authority
key_terms.خَلَقْتُكَ: I created you; affirms divine creation of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.رُوحِي: My Spirit; an expression of divine bestowal of honor
key_terms.عَصَاكَ: disobeyed you; refusal of the Prophet’s command as disobedience to Allah
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: ʿAlī; the Imam whose obedience is also made obligatory
key_terms.نَسْلِهِ: his offspring; referring to the progeny of ʿAlī عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the obligation of obedience to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله and Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a divine address to the Prophet Muḥammad (صلى الله عليه وآله) affirming his honored creation and the obligation of obedience to him. It also extends that divinely mandated obedience to ʿAlī (عليه السلام) and selected ones from his progeny, expressing their special status and authority.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad, from Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Abu Hamza who said, 
‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying:

‘Allahazwj the Exalted Revealed unto Muhammadsaww: “[19:9] and indeed I Created you before, when you were nothing, and Iazwj Blew into yousaww of Myazwj Spirit, a Prestige from Meazwj. Iazwj Honoured yousaww with it when Iazwj Obligated the obedience to yousaww upon Myazwj creatures altogether. So the one who obeys yousaww, so he has obeyed Meazwj, and the one who disobeys yousaww, so he has disobeyed Meazwj; and Iazwj Obligated that regarding Aliasws and regarding hisasws offspring from the onesasws whom Iazwj Chose from them for Myselfazwj’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ahmad ibn Idris has narrated al-Husayn ibn ‘Abdallah from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa and Muhammad ibn ‘Abdallah from Ali ibn Hadid from Murazim from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.

“Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, has said, “O Muhammad I have created you and Ali a ligh, a spirit, without body before I created My heavens, My earth, My Throne, and My ocean. You continued acknowledge Me as you’re the Lord and speak of My glory. I then collected the spirits of both of you and made it one spirit. This spirit continued to speak of My Glory, My Holiness and acknowledge Me as the Lord. I then divided it into two and two which became four: one Muhammad one Ali, al-Hassan and al-Husayn the two of them. Then Allah created Fatima (a.s.) from the spirit that was created first without a body. He then wiped us with his right hand to allow his light reach us all.
